name: Magic Speed Date
source:
Tired of boring dates with ordinary humans? 'Twinkle' is the ultimate app for connecting with beings from another world. Swipe, get a match, and go on a date with fascinating creatures.

[Translated from [url=https://pinkchocoball.itch.io/magic-speed-date]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
厌倦了与普通人类的无聊约会吗？“星烁”是一款能让你与异世界生灵牵线搭桥的终极交友软件。指尖轻滑、成功配对，与魅力非凡的奇幻生物开启浪漫约会吧。

[译自[url=https://pinkchocoball.itch.io/magic-speed-date]itch.io[/url]]
